text:
maria: Heads-up: sketching a small perf/cost widget for the console — per-route amortized cost forecast that accounts for cache savings and session stickiness. Want feedback on telemetry + UX.
sam: love it. main question: how do we attribute cache savings? per-request? per-session amortization? both?
maria: leaning session-amortized + prefetched-keyline credits. idea is to split prefetch savings across the sessions that actually used the cached prefix, not the originating request only.
jon: that's risky for noisy sampling — we'd need deterministic ties to route ids and session hashes. otherwise the variance will make the dashboard jumpy.
luis: API side: we'd need a couple new telemetry fields: route_id, session_hash, prefetch_bucket, prefetch_tokens_saved. make them optional to avoid inflating payloads.
maria: rough proto for the invoke event payload: 
```
event_type: "invoke"
route_id: "checkout"
session_hash: "sha256(...)"
tokens_generated: 420
prefetch_saved: 120
model_sku: "rwd-7b-quant"
```
sam: UI ask: show a toggle between 'amortized per-active-session' vs 'raw per-call' savings. tooltip explains sampling and CI. mockup will include a sparkline + CI band.
jon: ops note: adding session_hash and prefetch_saved is fine but we should gate full-payload ingestion behind a sampling knob. propose: 100% ingest of minimal fields (route_id, session_hash hash, tokens_generated) and 1% for full prefetch metadata to estimate bias.
maria: agreed. can we compute an unbiased estimator from sampled prefetch metadata? if so we can keep UI stable without 100% payloads.
luis: yes, we can. I'll add an importance-weighted aggregator in the analytics pipeline. will spec in PR.
sam: UX next steps: I'll wire the toggle and add the explainer copy + sample rate indicator. also add a small 'why numbers change' modal.
jon: I'll run a 24h variance sim with synthetic workloads and different sampling rates and post the numbers here tomorrow.
maria: thanks — plan: luis to spec telemetry PR, jon to run sim, sam to push a console toggle mock. pinging @luis @jon @sam for ownership. :rocket:
luis: on it, PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
sam: mock done, posting screenshot to Figma link in a bit.
jon: sim started, will share charts. suspected CI width will be acceptable at 1% for top routes.
maria: awesome work team — will slot a short sync in tomorrow if anything surprises us. :calendar:
